title: Northwind Analytics
story: A $12M B2B analytics company growing 51% a year. Growth looks healthy at the top line, but a third of everything won is given straight back — and the churn is concentrated in one segment the blended number completely hides.
watch_for: Segment-level churn versus the blended rate

title: Meridian Cloud
tagline: Early stage, running out of road
story: A £2.4M developer-tools business at 38% SMB churn, burning cash to grow. The unit economics have not closed yet and the runway is short enough that the financing calendar is starting to drive operating decisions.
watch_for: Cash runway and burn multiple against growth

title: Atlas Enterprise Software
story: A €45M enterprise ERP vendor with 79% gross margins and best-in-class retention. The risk is not performance — it is that nearly half of revenue sits with ten customers, which caps valuation regardless of how good the margins look.
